item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Explains How X-MEN Universe Connects To, And Differs From, Previous Movies
item.description: A new Avengers: Doomsday rumour reveals more about the X-Men Universe we'll visit in the upcoming blockbuster, including how it differs from the previous X-Men movies.

item.title: SCREAM 7 Super Bowl TV Spot And Poster Is All About The Original Final Girl, Sidney Prescott
item.description: The Big Game TV spot for Scream 7 has been released, but can the original Final Girl—Neve Campbell's Sidney Prescott—put an end to Ghostface's plan to kill her daughter?

item.title: PONIES Stars Artjom Gilz & Petro Ninovskyi On The Spy Game, Courting Emilia Clarke, & More! (Exclusive)
item.description: With Ponies now streaming on Peacock, we recently sat down with stars Artjom Gilz and Petro Ninovskyi to talk about their pivotal roles in the critically acclaimed spy series starring Emilia Clarke!

item.title: DC Studios' Super Bowl 2026 Plans Revealed (And There's More Bad News For Marvel Fans)
item.description: Marvel Studios is skipping the Super Bowl this weekend, but what of DC Studios and Supergirl? Well, the Woman of Tomorrow will be spotlighted, but not during the Big Game.

item.title: JURASSIC PARK's Sam Neill, Laura Dern, And Jeff Goldblum, Return For New Big Game TV Spot
item.description: Ahead of this weekend's Super Bowl, Jurassic Park stars Sam Neill, Laura Dern, and Jeff Goldblum return as Alan Grant, Ellie Sattler, and Ian Malcolm for a Big Game TV spot.

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2 Character Posters Spotlight The Straw Hats And Their Latest Recruit
item.description: As the Straw Hat Pirates prepare to head into uncharted waters in the second season of One Piece, Netflix has released a series of character posters spotlighting Monkey D. Luffy and his crew...
